prompts.prompt_text: Research the current state of decentralized identity standards. Focus on DID methods, verifiable credentials, and the W3C specification landscape.
Investigate the technical architecture of prediction market resolution mechanisms. Compare Augur, Polymarket, and Gnosis approaches.
Deep dive into LMSR (Logarithmic Market Scoring Rule) mathematics. Derive the cost function, explain liquidity parameter sensitivity.
Surface resonance patterns from my previous research sessions. What themes keep recurring? What questions remain unresolved?
Design a research pipeline for evaluating zero-knowledge proof systems. Define stages, quality gates, and output artifacts.
Create a meta-research configuration for competitive analysis of AI agent frameworks. Specify depth, breadth, and source requirements.
Audit the sources used in my last research session. Verify citations, check for fabricated references, and assess source quality.
